aquatic_dolphin.name: Dolphin
aquatic_dolphin.fact_1: Dolphins are friendly, intelligent marine mammals that breathe air through a blowhole on top of their head!
aquatic_dolphin.fact_2: Dolphins talk to each other under the sea using clicks and whistles and love leaping over waves.
aquatic_dolphin.activity: Dolphin Wave Leap: Put your hands together in front and make a smooth jumping wave motion through the air!

aquatic_whale.name: Whale
aquatic_whale.fact_1: The Blue Whale is the largest animal ever to live on Earth—even bigger than the biggest dinosaurs!
aquatic_whale.fact_2: Whales sing deep, gentle underwater songs that travel for miles through the ocean.
aquatic_whale.activity: Whale Spout Breath: Take a deep breath in and blow a gentle 'Whoosh' up toward the ceiling like a whale's water spout!

aquatic_shark.name: Shark
aquatic_shark.fact_1: Sharks have skeletons made of flexible cartilage instead of hard bone, helping them swim swiftly!
aquatic_shark.fact_2: A shark's triangular dorsal fin glides through the water to keep it balanced.
aquatic_shark.activity: Fin Glide: Place one hand on top of your head like a shark fin and swim smoothly in a circle!

aquatic_octopus.name: Octopus
aquatic_octopus.fact_1: An octopus has eight flexible arms lined with little suction cups and three hearts!
aquatic_octopus.fact_2: Octopuses are masters of camouflage and can change their skin color in the blink of an eye.
aquatic_octopus.activity: Eight Wavy Arms: Wiggle all your fingers and arms like a graceful octopus swaying in the sea!

aquatic_sea_turtle.name: Sea Turtle
aquatic_sea_turtle.fact_1: Sea turtles have a hard protective shell and flipper-like legs that let them glide gracefully through the ocean!
aquatic_sea_turtle.fact_2: Mother sea turtles return to the exact same sandy beach where they were born to lay their eggs.
aquatic_sea_turtle.activity: Turtle Flipper Swim: Sweep both arms slowly back and forth like a sea turtle gliding over coral reefs!

aquatic_crab.name: Crab
aquatic_crab.fact_1: Crabs have ten legs—their front two legs have strong pincers called claws!
aquatic_crab.fact_2: Because of the way their leg joints bend, crabs love walking sideways across the sandy beach.
aquatic_crab.activity: Sideways Crab Walk: Pinch your thumbs and fingers like crab claws and take three steps sideways!

aquatic_jellyfish.name: Jellyfish
aquatic_jellyfish.fact_1: Jellyfish have umbrella-shaped bells that pulse gently to float through the water—and they are 95% water!
aquatic_jellyfish.fact_2: Jellyfish have drifted through Earth's oceans for hundreds of millions of years.
aquatic_jellyfish.activity: Umbrella Float: Open and close your hands softly like an umbrella pulsing gently in the ocean!

aquatic_seahorse.name: Seahorse
aquatic_seahorse.fact_1: A seahorse is a tiny fish with a head shaped like a little horse and a curly tail that holds onto seagrass!
aquatic_seahorse.fact_2: Unlike most animals, it is the father seahorse who carries the babies in a safe pouch until they hatch.
aquatic_seahorse.activity: Curly Tail Hold: Curl one finger around your other wrist like a seahorse holding onto a piece of seagrass!

aquatic_starfish.name: Starfish
aquatic_starfish.fact_1: Most starfish have five arms radiating from the center like a star in the sky!
aquatic_starfish.fact_2: Underneath its arms, a starfish has hundreds of tiny tube feet that help it crawl and hold onto rocks.
aquatic_starfish.activity: Five-Point Star Pose: Stand with your legs apart and arms stretched wide so your whole body looks like a starfish!

insect_butterfly.name: Butterfly
insect_butterfly.fact_1: Butterflies start life as tiny caterpillars before transforming inside a chrysalis into winged beauties!
insect_butterfly.fact_2: Butterflies taste flower petals with special sensors on their feet.
insect_butterfly.activity: Butterfly Flutter: Hook your thumbs together and spread your fingers to flutter your hands like butterfly wings!

insect_honeybee.name: Honeybee
insect_honeybee.fact_1: Honeybees visit thousands of flowers to collect nectar and make golden sweet honey in hexagonal wax combs!
insect_honeybee.fact_2: By carrying pollen from flower to flower, bees help apple, mango, and vegetable plants grow fruit.
insect_honeybee.activity: Busy Bee Buzz: Wiggle your fingers like tiny wings and hum a happy 'Bzzzz-bzzzz' from flower to flower!

insect_ant.name: Ant
insect_ant.fact_1: Ants are super strong—a tiny ant can lift and carry leaves and crumbs up to 20 times its own body weight!
insect_ant.fact_2: Ants live in big underground cities called colonies and work together as a team.
insect_ant.activity: Ant March: March in a neat straight line with your friends like hard-working little ants!

insect_dragonfly.name: Dragonfly
insect_dragonfly.fact_1: Dragonflies have four shimmering transparent wings that let them hover in mid-air and even fly backward!
insect_dragonfly.fact_2: Their big compound eyes allow them to see in almost every direction at once.
insect_dragonfly.activity: Hover Helicopter: Hold both arms out like shimmering dragonfly wings and freeze in a steady hover!

insect_grasshopper.name: Grasshopper
insect_grasshopper.fact_1: Grasshoppers have long, spring-loaded hind legs that launch them high into the air like little catapults!
insect_grasshopper.fact_2: They make cheerful summer music by rubbing their back legs against their wings.
insect_grasshopper.activity: Meadow Leap: Crouch down low like a grasshopper in the grass and jump up on the count of three!

insect_ladybug.name: Ladybug
insect_ladybug.fact_1: Ladybugs look like shiny red domes with neat black polka dots—and underneath their red shell are hidden wings!
insect_ladybug.fact_2: Gardeners love ladybugs because they protect flowers and vegetables from tiny pests.
insect_ladybug.activity: Spot Count: Pretend to count seven little black spots on the back of your hand like a lucky red ladybug!

insect_spider.name: Spider
insect_spider.fact_1: Spiders are arachnids with eight legs, and they spin intricate, silky geometric webs that sparkle with morning dew!
insect_spider.fact_2: Spider silk is stronger than steel thread of the same thickness.
insect_spider.activity: Itsy Bitsy Climb: Touch your left thumb to right pinky, then right thumb to left pinky to climb up like a little spider!

insect_snail.name: Snail
insect_snail.fact_1: A snail carries its spiral shell house right on its back wherever it goes and can tuck inside when it wants to rest!
insect_snail.fact_2: Snails glide smoothly on a single muscular foot and have tiny eyes at the tips of their tentacles.
insect_snail.activity: Slow Snail Glide: Move across the floor in super-slow motion while carrying an imaginary spiral house on your back!

reptile_frog.name: Frog
reptile_frog.fact_1: Frogs are amphibians that hatch in water as swimming tadpoles and grow legs to hop onto land!
reptile_frog.fact_2: Tree frogs have sticky round pads on their toes to climb smooth green leaves.
reptile_frog.activity: Lily Pad Hop: Squat down on an imaginary green lily pad, say 'Ribbit!', and hop to the next pad!

reptile_crocodile.name: Crocodile
reptile_crocodile.fact_1: Crocodiles have tough, scaly armor plates along their backs that warm up like solar panels in the sun!
reptile_crocodile.fact_2: When a crocodile rests on the riverbank with its mouth open, it is actually cooling itself down.
reptile_crocodile.activity: Snap & Smile: Stretch both arms straight in front and open and close them gently like a resting crocodile basking in the sun!

reptile_snake.name: Snake
reptile_snake.fact_1: Snakes have no legs at all, yet they glide smoothly across the ground and up trees using special belly scales!
reptile_snake.fact_2: Snakes flick their forked tongues in and out to smell the air around them.
reptile_snake.activity: Slither Wave: Curve your hand in a smooth S-wave and make a gentle 'Ssssss' sound!

reptile_lizard.name: Lizard
reptile_lizard.fact_1: Lizards are cold-blooded reptiles that love doing little push-ups on warm sunny rocks in the morning!
reptile_lizard.fact_2: Many lizards can safely regrow their tail if it ever gets caught.
reptile_lizard.activity: Sunny Rock Push-Up: Do two gentle push-ups on the floor like a lizard warming up in the morning sun!

reptile_chameleon.name: Chameleon
reptile_chameleon.fact_1: Chameleons can change the color of their skin to match their mood, temperature, and leafy surroundings!
reptile_chameleon.fact_2: A chameleon's two eyes can look in two completely different directions at the same time.
reptile_chameleon.activity: Color Change Pose: Freeze completely still next to something green or blue and pretend to blend right in like a chameleon!

reptile_tortoise.name: Tortoise
reptile_tortoise.fact_1: A tortoise walks on land with sturdy, elephant-like feet and carries a high, domed protective shell!
reptile_tortoise.fact_2: Tortoises walk slowly and peacefully, and they can live for more than 100 years!
reptile_tortoise.activity: Steady Tortoise Walk: Remember 'Slow and steady wins the race'—take four calm, patient tortoise steps!

everyday_ball.name: Ball
everyday_ball.description: A round, bouncy play ball is great for kicking, catching, and rolling with friends outdoors!

everyday_book.name: Book
everyday_book.description: Books are filled with stories, pictures, and knowledge that take our imagination on wonderful adventures!

everyday_pencil.name: Pencil
everyday_pencil.description: We hold a pencil to write letters, numbers, and draw creative pictures on paper.

everyday_chair.name: Chair
everyday_chair.description: A sturdy chair has four legs and a backrest so we can sit comfortably while reading or eating.

everyday_table.name: Table
everyday_table.description: A table has a flat top where families gather to eat meals, study, and build puzzles.

everyday_clock.name: Clock
everyday_clock.description: A clock has numbers from 1 to 12 and moving hands that tell us the time of day!

everyday_umbrella.name: Umbrella
everyday_umbrella.description: An umbrella opens like a canopy overhead to keep us dry in the rain and shaded from hot sun.

everyday_shoes.name: Shoes
everyday_shoes.description: We wear comfortable shoes on our feet to protect them when walking, running, and playing outside.

everyday_bag.name: Bag
everyday_bag.description: A school backpack bag has shoulder straps to carry our books, pencils, and lunchbox neatly.

everyday_bottle.name: Bottle
everyday_bottle.description: A reusable water bottle keeps clean drinking water ready so we stay hydrated all day!

everyday_cup.name: Cup
everyday_cup.description: A cup has a curved handle so we can hold it safely to drink warm milk or water.

everyday_spoon.name: Spoon
everyday_spoon.description: We use a clean spoon to scoop and eat soup, rice, yogurt, and cereal.

everyday_toothbrush.name: Toothbrush
everyday_toothbrush.description: A toothbrush has soft bristles that clean our teeth every morning and night for a bright smile!

everyday_bed.name: Bed
everyday_bed.description: A cozy bed has a soft mattress, pillow, and blanket where we sleep and recharge every night.

nature_rainbow.name: Rainbow
nature_rainbow.description: A rainbow appears in the sky when sunlight shines through raindrops, showing seven glowing colors!

nature_sun.name: Sun
nature_sun.description: The Sun is a bright star at the center of our solar system that gives Earth warm daylight and helps plants grow!

nature_moon.name: Moon
nature_moon.description: The Moon shines softly in the night sky and changes shape from a thin crescent to a bright full circle!

nature_stars.name: Stars
nature_stars.description: Stars are distant suns twinkling across the night sky in beautiful patterns called constellations.

nature_cloud.name: Cloud
nature_cloud.description: Clouds float in the sky and are made of tiny water droplets that bring refreshing rain to the Earth.

nature_tree.name: Tree
nature_tree.description: Trees have deep roots, a sturdy trunk, and green leaves that make fresh oxygen for us to breathe!

nature_flower.name: Flower
nature_flower.description: Flowers bloom with colorful petals and sweet fragrance, inviting bees and butterflies to visit.

nature_mountain.name: Mountain
nature_mountain.description: Mountains are giant landforms that rise high into the sky, often crowned with white snow at the peak!

nature_river.name: River
nature_river.description: A river is a flowing ribbon of fresh water that travels from mountains down through valleys to the sea.

nature_waterfall.name: Waterfall
nature_waterfall.description: A waterfall happens where a river tumbles over a high rocky cliff into a misty pool below!

nature_ocean.name: Ocean
nature_ocean.description: The ocean is a vast body of salty water that covers most of our planet and is home to whales, dolphins, and coral reefs!
